subject: Mutual action plan & next steps — MediaLabs discovery
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@medialabs.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-01T15:10:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap and proposed mutual action plan

Thanks again for taking the time today, Sanjay — great conversation. Quick recap and a suggested mutual action plan so we have aligned owners and dates.

Top pain we heard
- Latency spikes on inference during peak publishing windows (10x traffic bursts) causing content-generation timeouts.
- High per-token TCO with current provider and limited ability to run in dedicated capacity for sensitive training data.
- Need for regional routing (US/EU) for both compliance and latency.

Success criteria you outlined
1) 95th percentile inference latency < 300ms for 512-token flows during peak.
2) Pilot demonstrates 30% lower per-token cost vs current setup.
3) SOC2 evidence and VPC options for editorial PII workflows.

Suggested mutual action plan (proposed owners & dates)
- M1 (Week 1–2): Pilot kickoff & baseline metrics collection — Owner: MediaLabs (Sanjay) / Redwood (Hannah). Target start: 2028-06-10
- M2 (Week 2–4): Integration + regional routing config + SSO test — Owner: MediaLabs (Alicia) / Redwood (Karthik). Target complete: 2028-06-28
- M3 (Week 5–8): Load-based performance tuning & cost profile report — Owner: Redwood (Platform Eng) / MediaLabs (Infra). Target complete: 2028-07-26
- Decision: Exec review & procurement signoff — Owner: MediaLabs (VP Eng) / Redwood (Sales). Target decision date: 2028-08-09

Immediate asks (for this week)
- Sanjay: share contact for procurement (procurement@ or Alicia) and current 1-week traffic traces (preferred) by 2028-06-04.
- MediaLabs: confirm ability to run test in staging with sample traffic by 2028-06-07.
- Redwood: provide SOC2 summary, SSO integration guide, and a one-page pilot pricing sheet by 2028-06-03.

I've attached a short Mutual Action Plan template for editing (redwood-mpa-template.pdf) and included links to our SOC2 summary and SSO guide in the next email. If these owners/dates look off, tell me what to change and I'll update the doc.

Next step: I'll follow up tomorrow with the SOC2 + SSO links and a draft pilot quote.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-mpa-template.pdf (application/pdf)

Date: 2028-06-03T18:25:00Z
Subject: Internal: MediaLabs — prepare pilot pricing and procurement package

Karthik / Jordan — quick internal ask following the MediaLabs call. Sanjay wants a procurement-ready quote and confirmation of pilot capacity options. Key points:
- Pilot length: 90 days preferred, target start week of 2028-06-10.
- Technical constraints: must support regional routing (us + eu), can run in staging under MediaLabs creds, needs SAML SSO.
- Success metrics: 95th pctl latency < 300ms; pilot should show at least 25–30% cost reduction vs their current provider.

Please prepare:
1) A one-page pilot pricing sheet with committed capacity and burst tiers (for proposal-medialabs-quote.xlsx).
2) Short procurement packet: SOC2 extract, sub-processor list, and a titled line-item for PO processing.
3) A short tech note on how we'll measure latency and attach the baseline metrics template.

Can you get drafts to me by EOD 2028-06-03 so I can upload to Drive and share with Alicia tomorrow morning? If you need product/engineering clarifications, loop in Platform Eng and copy me.

Thanks — Hannah
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
